g.text: CONTROL DATA FLOW GRAPH (CDFG) — Critical-Path Function
Function: authenticate_and_read_block(block=4, keyA) | T_exec: 28,500 µs | Deadline: 35,000 µs | Slack: 6,500 µs
D1: Load Key A & UID Operands
Rx Nt -> State0 = f(Key,UID,Nt) -> Enc ar (42 µs)
Send ar = Nr ^ k1..32 over RF (5,200 µs)
